context_requirements: Expression of functional NPY1R, NPY2R, NPY5R or MCOLN3 in the assayed cell line
An active endogenous neuropeptide tone or autocrine/paracrine NPY-family ligand for antagonist activity to be detectable
G-protein signaling machinery coupled to the expressed receptor subtype
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and not explained by generic stress
Evidence of NPY receptor-mediated signaling output (e.g., cAMP/Ca2+ reporter) in these lines under the same conditions
